summary: Using a ProxyCommand jump host forces a new SSH connection for every task even with persistent connections, so avoid jump hosts to keep the performance benefit.
questions: Does using a jump host slow down network playbooks?
Do persistent connections work through ProxyCommand?

answer_card.title: Jump hosts hurt performance
answer_card.answer_md: With a `ProxyCommand` jump host, Ansible opens a new SSH connection for **every task**, even with persistent connections (`network_cli`, `netconf`). Avoid jump hosts where possible to keep the persistent-connection speedup.
